highlights.text: Adjusted operating margin of 22.6%, up 410 basis points compared to second quarter 2025.
• Operating cash flow of $1,100 million and adjusted free cash flow of $925 million, an increase of 241% and 234%, respectively, compared to prior year second quarter.
Full Year 2026 Guidance • Expects full year 2026 net sales of $14,000 million and organic sales growth of 31%, each at the midpoint of guidance, compared to full year 2025.

Adjusted operating margin was 22.6%, up 410 basis points compared to second quarter 2025, driven by operational execution, continued strong productivity, and favorable price-cost, inclusive of tariff impacts and associated countermeasures.

We see a demand environment that continues to grow, and we continue to invest ahead of it — planting seeds now that we expect to compound for years to come.” Adjusted Free Cash Flow and Liquidity Net cash generated by operating activities in the second quarter was $1,100 million, and adjusted free cash flow was $925 million, increasing 241% and 234%, respectively, from second quarter 2025.
Capital expenditures for full year 2026 are expected to be approximately 4.0% of revenue, at the high end of the range.
Updated Full Year and Third Quarter 2026 Guidance The data center market continues to demonstrate strong momentum, with demand fundamentals reinforcing the durability of the growth environment.
